summary: Verified Phase 1 of the AI Employee Builder feature end-to-end on web. Backend: 12/12 pytest passing across templates catalog, dashboard, employee CRUD (blank/template/job_description), profile PATCH with status validation, training documents (add + validation + delete), examples (add + delete), completeness scoring, and 404 guards. Web UI: /ai-builder dashboard loads with stats + 16 template cards + your-AI-employees grid; create-from-template flow navigates to /ai-builder/:id; profile Save updates name + status and header; Training tab adds a document; Examples tab adds a good example; completeness rose from 20% -> 40% and the Training/Examples tab counters incremented to (1); Create modal supports Blank + Template + Job description sources and JD extraction parses bullet lines into responsibilities. All 4 TEST_ employees created during testing were cleaned up.

issues: Unrelated 'Credit specials' upsell modal auto-opens on dashboard nav (from a global provider, not the AI Builder page) and can intercept clicks. Not part of this feature but worth flagging — dismiss via 'Maybe later' works.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/ai_employee_builder.py `dashboard()` returns 'training' inside `by_status` only when >0, but the flat `training` key is also emitted at the top level via `count("Training")` — good. Frontend AIEmployeeBuilder.jsx currently does not surface the 'training' stat card even though backend returns it; consider showing it or dropping it from the backend response to reduce noise.

routes/ai_employee_builder.py `_completeness` runs 8 separate count_documents queries per employee list-entry — for a large workspace `GET /api/ai-builder/employees` will do N*8 round trips. Consider aggregating or caching once the workspace grows past ~50 employees.

Frontend EmployeeProfile.jsx `ProfileTab` initializes local state from `employee` prop once via useState — after a parent `load()` refresh, the form still shows stale values until you remount. Not blocking (Save works and toast fires) but a small UX gap: consider keying ProfileTab by `employee.updated_at` or syncing via useEffect.

routes/ai_employee_builder.py `AddDocument`: `content` upper bound is enforced only implicitly via the 2000-char slice on `content_preview`. Consider validating full `content` length (e.g. <= 100k) to prevent oversized payloads.
test_credentials: Demo owner: amit@demo.team / Demo@2026 (also usable via POST /api/auth/demo-login which sets tn_session cookie)
seed_data_creation: No seed data required — templates are served statically from services/ai_employee_templates.py. All test-created employees (TEST_UI_*, TEST_Blank_Emp, TEST_JD_Emp, TEST_Lifecycle_Emp, TEST_Updated_Name) were cleaned up via DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Employee Builder Phase 1 backend + web UI is stable. Endpoints under /api/ai-builder/* are auth-gated and workspace-scoped. Templates count = 16 (including 'custom'). Completeness score has 10 checks (10% per check). Phase 2 additions (style profiles, permissions, tools, escalation rules, test runs, deployments) already have counters wired into `_completeness()` but the Phase 1 UI doesn't expose those tabs yet — future phases should add them.
